🧠 Crypto News Brief: Markets kick off September with resilience as Bitcoin holds key support near $78,500. Institutional inflows, real-world asset tokenization, and privacy asset surges continue to anchor broader ecosystem confidence. 👑 BlackRock’s BUIDL Fund Hits $2.8 Billion to Reclaim Tokenized Treasury Crown BlackRock's BUIDL fund has expanded to $2.8 billion in assets under management across eight blockchain networks. The growth positions the fund back at the top of the tokenized real-world asset (RWA) market as institutional adoption accelerates. Read full story ⚡ Bitcoin Battles Back Above $78,500 as Bulls Eye $80,000 Breakout Bitcoin mounted a firm recovery from a brief dip toward $77,000, stabilizing above $78,500. Broader market sentiment remains supported following a 25% monthly gain for August and steady demand for US spot ETFs. More details 🚀 Zcash Outpaces Major Crypto Assets With Massive 82% August Rally Privacy-focused Zcash (ZEC) led large-cap digital asset performance into September with an 82% monthly surge. The rally outpaced top crypto benchmarks during a broader $500 billion rebound in total cryptocurrency market capitalization. Read more 📊 FedWatch Signals Hawkish Shift With 57% Odds of September Rate Hike Interest rate derivatives show a shifting outlook ahead of the Federal Reserve's September FOMC meeting. CME FedWatch metrics now price in a 57% probability of a rate increase as traders evaluate inflation figures. See details 💠 Ethereum Targets $2,800 Breakout Following Record ETF Net Inflows Spot Ethereum ETFs registered a record weekly net inflow of $824 million, strengthening spot demand. Technical indicators show ETH consolidating near the $2,550 resistance zone as analysts eye $2,800 targets. Read full story 🌐 TON Bridge Shuts Down Official Cross-Chain Route as Deadline Arrives The official TON Bridge v3 connecting Toncoin with Ethereum and BNB Chain is officially shutting down as of September 1. Users holding wrapped TON or j-tokens were required to migrate assets back to native TON contracts before the bridge cutoff. Bringing global finance onchain



 
Highlights
 
Aave App Enters Early Access on iOS
Early access to the Aave App started on August 26 on iOS. The first cohort of users received Ghost Passes, which are invites that
let friends and family skip the waitlist. More passes are being given out through the Aave Instagram, Telegram, and on X.
Announcement here [https://x.com/aave/status/2092643144139424046].
 
Coinbase Tokenized Stocks Coming to V4
Coinbase Tokenized Stocks went live on Base, and Aave V4 will be the first credit market to fully support them. Once V4 is
deployed on Base, users will be able to borrow stablecoins against tokenized stocks. Only available in eligible geos outside the
U.S. Announcement here [https://x.com/aave/status/2091964981675704495].
 
Aave V4 Crosses $800M Deposits
Aave V4 crossed $800 million deposits on August 27, while active loans set a new all-time high. Announcement here
[https://x.com/aave/status/2093013562788598243].
 
New incentives are also live for USDC borrowers [https://x.com/aave/status/2094433298567090579] in the Core Hub on Ethereum.
Borrow USDC against any available collateral and earn 2% back in USDC rewards.
 
EtherFi Cash Now Runs on V4
EtherFi moved its Cash credit backend to a dedicated Aave V4 instance on Optimism, letting more than 100,000 cardholders borrow
against their portfolios. Supported collateral includes PAXG, SPYx, WBTC, ETH, and ETHFI, with more coming as the integration
expands. Deposits on the deployment crossed $100 million in its first week. Announcement here
[https://x.com/aave/status/2088265181230969095].
